annotations.title: Edit my website by talking to Emma

description: Edit your site by talking to Emma in plain words (description, capabilities, logo or hero image by https URL, links, generate an image…). Requires the site key as Bearer token.

image_urls.description: optional https image URLs to use (logo, photo…)

message.description: what to change on the site, in plain words (or "status")

site_key.description: your site key (sk_…), for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header; the Authorization: Bearer header wins when both are present

name: talk_to_emma

code.description: machine-readable reason when ok is false

images.description: URLs of images Emma generated or placed
